title: The Echo Between Roads
summary: A second 120-minute phase from level 11 to 20: guided signal work and class mastery at 11-14, a punishing but recoverable sensorium phase-lag plus explicit Sol synchrony at 15-18, and stabilized readiness at 19-20. Exact limiter, reconstruction, transition, and gate mechanisms remain unspecified.

chapters.title: Signal After Shaklas
chapters.summary: Review a copied packet and preserve people before coordinates.

chapters.title: Routes Without Owners
chapters.summary: Inspect physical relay evidence and establish a safe five-point baseline.

chapters.title: The Echo Takes Hold
chapters.summary: Enter the shock band and stabilize sight while the phase-lag is strongest.

chapters.title: Five Anchors
chapters.summary: Stabilize sound, touch, balance, and present identity under peak pressure.

chapters.title: The Second Horizon
chapters.summary: Rehabilitate the handicap and complete a normal-pressure level-20 readiness capstone.

competencies.label: Bound an uncertain signal
competencies.description: Separate source, current evidence, unknowns, expiration, and return.

competencies.label: Keep people before coordinates
competencies.description: Preserve public need without constructing a traveler profile.

competencies.label: Inspect a frequency without inventing an owner
competencies.description: Use physical hardware evidence while leaving unsupported identity and mechanism unspecified.

competencies.label: Establish recovery before exposure
competencies.description: Test five ordinary references, a stop condition, and a physical return.

competencies.label: Survive the phase-lag onset
competencies.description: Enter the level-15 shock with visible recovery tools and agency intact.

competencies.label: Anchor the live sightline
competencies.description: Distinguish body position, delayed images, and return rail.

competencies.label: Anchor the live signal
competencies.description: Separate live tone, copied echo, and local safety pulse.

competencies.label: Anchor touch, balance, and chosen self
competencies.description: Use local physical references and an explicit identity boundary under peak pressure.

competencies.label: Return without false certainty
competencies.description: Clear the active handicap while preserving the unresolved cause.

competencies.label: Reach the second horizon
competencies.description: Complete level-20 readiness without claiming automatic passage or ownership.

competencies.label: Carry a chosen class discipline
competencies.description: Choose or preserve one authored class branch, exercise its primary and follow-up, and select or affirm impact/tempo mastery.

competencies.label: Choose partnership in the present
competencies.description: Select and exercise Sol’s Balanced, Guard, or Assault order under live echo pressure.

bands.label: Guided re-entry
bands.summary: Levels 11-14 remain forgiving while the player learns bounded signals, privacy, relay evidence, and recovery protocol.

bands.label: Echo shock onset
bands.summary: Level 15 is the hardest sensory impact: duplicated cues compromise offense, defense, and timing while the player still owns every command.

bands.label: Echo pressure
bands.summary: Level 16 remains punishing while the sight anchor begins returning control.

bands.label: Echo adaptation
bands.summary: Level 17 demands deliberate timing, recovery, and class discipline rather than repeated basic attacks.

bands.label: Echo endurance
bands.summary: Level 18 remains dangerous, but all five anchors should make the player capable rather than helpless.

bands.label: Stabilized horizon
bands.summary: Levels 19-20 return to average pressure so recovery and the capstone test mastery instead of accumulated impairment.

injury.label: Between-Worlds sensory echo
injury.summary: Present sensory cues and a delayed relay echo arrive out of order. The game does not declare whether the cause is limiter-adjacent, transition residue, reconstruction interaction, Between Worlds, or another mechanism.
injury.onset_text: The repeater answers with your own movement a fraction late. Sight, sound, touch, and balance disagree at once. Sol can see the disruption but cannot name its cause. This is a new shock trial, not a solved piece of canon.
injury.recovery_text: Use the five-point anchor band, REST, DEFENSE, WITHDRAW STATUS, Sol’s Guard order, and the authored sight/sound/body milestones. The active penalty improves across levels 16-18 and clears at level 19.

post_phase_epilogue.title: The People Behind the Signal
post_phase_epilogue.summary: A level-20 field epilogue exercises bounded formation, partner synchrony, evidence handling, counter-signals, and fresh scoped consent without changing the 120-minute phase target or claiming full multiplayer authority.

epilogue_competencies.label: Bounded field formation
epilogue_competencies.description: Choose Balanced, Offensive, or Defensive emphasis without changing ownership, progression, or refusal.

epilogue_competencies.label: Player-triggered partner synchrony
epilogue_competencies.description: Trigger one bounded synchronized maneuver with Sol while retaining the next committed action.
